subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention & audit logs (Redwood + Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention & audit logs (Redwood + Acme Health)

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the security/compliance items that matter most for Acme Health's integration: 

Summary of Acme's primary pain points and goals:
- SOC 2 Type II evidence required before production access (hipaa-adjacent requirements).
- Detailed audit logs and retention policy for request/response data (ability to produce logs for audits).
- DPA and data residency clauses — need confirmation of control options and deletion workflows.
- Pen test evidence for the inference stack and endpoint scope; Acme will likely run a vendor penetration test as part of procurement.
- Clarification on key management (BYOK / KMS options) and whether Redwood holds plaintext customer data.

What we (Redwood) will provide by close of business Wednesday: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — attached.
- Pen test summary and remediation timeline — attached.
- Link to our standard DPA and a DocuSign route if you'd like to expedite.
- Short document describing audit log retention options and default retention (30 days token-level, configurable up to 7 years with enterprise plan).

Next steps / owners: 
1) Marissa (me) — send SOC 2 + pen test summary + DPA link (attached) — target: 2026-03-03 EOD.
2) Vivek — follow up on technical Qs around audit log endpoints and BYOK options; can set up brief tech call if needed.
3) Priya / Security team — confirm any additional evidence or scope for vendor pen test.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB), redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.txt (TXT, 120KB), redwood-dpa-v1.2.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

If helpful, I can open a short technical follow-up with Vivek & your security lead to run through the audit log formats and retention controls.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

From: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention & audit logs (Redwood + Acme Health)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report covers both hosted and dedicated deployments? We will need the scope to include inference endpoints.
- For the pen test summary, can you share the scope (public endpoints, internal infra) and whether recent critical/high findings were fully remediated?
- On BYOK: we prefer customer-managed keys (KMS). Is BYOK available on the dedicated/private offering or only for Private? Any limitations?
- We'll likely request a short staging environment to run our vendor pen test; what's your typical process and lead time?

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — it lists a couple of specific evidence asks (audit log format, log retention settings per stream, and incident response contacts).

Can we aim to have the SOC 2 and DPA in hand by end of week so procurement can move the PO forward?

Thanks,
Jared
Director, Security Architecture
Acme Health
[Attachment: acme-vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention & audit logs (Redwood + Acme Health)

Jared — thanks for the questions. Answers below and next steps: 

- SOC 2 scope: The attached SOC 2 Type II (redacted) covers our hosted API and inference endpoints used in the standard hosted offering. For Dedicated/Private we provide either the same scoped report when the environment is Redwood-managed, or we support attestation materials for customer-managed deployments — Vivek can follow up with specifics.

- Pen test scope & remediation: Attached is our pen test summary (redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.txt). Scope included public inference endpoints and internal orchestration components; the report includes remediation notes and status — all critical findings were remediated in Q4 2025. For customer-run vendor tests we provide a staging environment and a point of contact for coordination.

- BYOK / KMS: BYOK is supported on Redwood Private and Dedicated (customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest). Hosted customers can use Redwood-managed KMS but we also offer a bring-your-key option for enterprise contracts — Vivek will confirm the exact flow and any limitations for your procurement team.

- Staging for vendor pen test: Typical turnaround is 1-2 weeks from request; we will need a signed scoped NDA and dates for the test window. Vivek can own the env provisioning and provide the security contact.

Action items: 
- Marissa: upload SOC 2 (attached), DPA DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/sign/abc123) — DONE.
- Vivek: follow up with a short tech call to discuss log formats (JSON lines), retention configuration (default 30 days, configurable to 7 years), and BYOK implementation steps.
- Acme: confirm required artifacts from the VSA and preferred timeline for pen test.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 2 Mar 2026 at 09:08, Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> > Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report covers both hosted and dedicated deployments?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf, redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.txt, redwood-dpa-v1.2.pdf

Let me know if you'd like me to loop in product security or schedule a 30-minute tech sync.

Best,

Marissa

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention & audit logs (Redwood + Acme Health)

Thanks Marissa / Vivek — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple small follow-ups on retention and deletion: 

- Can you confirm the default retention for inference request logs (token-level): is the 30-day default applied to all hosted tiers?
- For data deletion requests (GDPR/HIPAA Right to be Forgotten), what is the typical SLA to delete customer data from backups & caches? (we need written confirmation for procurement)

We will review the SOC 2 and VSA and route any additional asks by end of this week. If possible, please include a short statement we can give procurement that summarizes retention/delete SLAs for hosted vs dedicated/private.

Thanks,
Priya
